entries.title: A card with a picture shows its words on your phone right away
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, a card with a picture showed only a sliver of its words until every picture had arrived, which could take a while when your phone had just come back in reach. The card's words now show as soon as the card opens, and its pictures fill in when they arrive.
entries.noPicture: The difference is how soon the words appear while a picture is still on its way; once the picture arrives the card looks as it did before.
